title.pt: YGO / HUB - Comunidade Yu-Gi-Oh! de Cajazeiras

subtitle.pt: Plataforma full-stack que organiza a comunidade local: eventos, decks, mercado, ranking e campeonatos.
subtitle.en: Full-stack platform that runs the local community: events, decks, marketplace, ranking, and tournaments.

summary.pt: Desenvolvi de ponta a ponta o hub da comunidade de Yu-Gi-Oh! da minha cidade. Os jogadores confirmam presença no evento semanal, montam decks, negociam cartas e disputam ranking e campeonatos.
summary.en: I built my city's Yu-Gi-Oh! community hub end to end. Players confirm attendance at the weekly event, build decks, trade cards, and compete in the ranking and tournaments.

pt: 12 usuários ativos e evento semanal aos sábados
Login por e-mail, Google e Discord, com papéis e painel administrativo
Redis, filas no RabbitMQ e arquivos no MinIO, tudo em Docker
PWA instalável, Open Graph dinâmico e SEO local
en: 12 active users and a weekly Saturday event
Sign-in with email, Google, and Discord, with roles and an admin panel
Redis, RabbitMQ queues, and MinIO file storage, all on Docker
Installable PWA, dynamic Open Graph, and local SEO
